title: 第7章 少年坐演武剑道始从心第8章 少年形影单站着如喽啰
content_zh:
灵鸟啼空山，桃花香可闻。
晨光熹微，小院中，一把木剑落井边，一只葫芦挂栅栏，少年已凝练元胎一个时辰，额头沁出细密的汗珠，凝练元胎的过程，是以自身丹田为基，沟通天地元气的过程，如同在平地打井，一口井的深度，决定了井中水的甘咧清澈与否。
元胎品质的高低鉴别，取决于凝练元胎时自身能够感应到的元气入丹田形成的元气颜色，以青为佳，以灰为次，而想要凝练出银色，甚至是金色，则需要天大的机缘以及个人要能承受住天地驳杂的元气入体时对身体洗练造成的极大痛楚。
顾余生咬紧牙关，坚持再坚持。
“呼！”
约莫一个时辰后，顾余生睁开眼，他瘦小的身体微微摇晃，整个人处于脱力状态，嘴唇上咬出牙痕。
“还是青色。”
顾余生喃喃自语，这几日，他日夜熬打，凝练元胎，在丹田中形成的元胎之气为青色。
也就是说，他的凝练的元胎为三品。
勉强可以算上品元胎。
但顾余生并不满意。
元胎境是修行之路的起始篇章，元胎的品阶好坏影响以后的修行大道能走多远，能攀多高。
“不够，还不够努力！”
顾余生稍作休息，再一次修炼太清元胎灵引诀，天地间的元气引导入丹田，一开始是呈现湛蓝色，但在顾余生的凝练下，逐渐转化为一团青色的元胎之气。
青取之于蓝而胜于蓝！
但青色想要再一次凝练为银色，顾余生却好似瞎子过河，摸索着前行。
又坚持了一阵。
丹田中的青色元气似乎多了一些。
顾余生倚栏凭坐，手微微颤抖，摘下挂在墙上的酒葫芦，从中倒出一小口入喉。
身体的疲乏之感很快消退，但酒中蕴含的元灵，却没有当日的那么神奇。

经过这几日的测试，顾余生已经弄清楚这神奇葫芦的作用，它应该能自动吸收天地间的元灵化入酒中，而这一过程，需要三五天时间，融入酒中的灵元，一旦离开酒葫芦，就会很快消散。
“修行的速度还是太慢了，照这样的速度下去，三年后，我最多能入开脉境，而开脉境需要打通人体的大部分经脉，过程更加漫长，这样下去，我凭什么与陆晨斗？我又何年才能取回那一把守护之剑？”
顾余生深吸一口气。
他已来桃花林数日，并无人师指导他修行，每日只能到镇妖碑前聆听各峰派来的长老开讲如何凝练元胎。
当。
当。
当。
青云门的钟磬声悠扬。
顾余生换了一套青云门服饰，快步向镇妖碑后方的演武场奔去。
演武场上，早已坐满了人。
都是新晋的青云门弟子，青云门占据六峰之地，新晋的弟子虽然被分配到六峰，但很多人天资平庸，只能在六峰的山脚开辟小院洞府，以外门弟子的身份修行，只有少数的人能够被六峰长老看中成为内门弟子，而被六峰峰主选中的人，则是青云门的亲传弟子。
青云梯有高低，青云门的弟子同样分等级。
而似顾余生这般，则是属于冷落的弟子，虽然也是外门弟子身份，实则连一个指导他修行的长老都没有，只能每日来演武场听轮值的长老授业。
当然，这些长老授业也未必肯倾囊相授，只是为了完成宗门任务，赚取不菲的宗门贡献点数。
顾余生找到一处无人的地方盘坐，尽管如此，还是有不少目光向他看来，并对他指指点点，窃窃私语，但顾余生早已习惯，不予理会。
少年盘坐身姿挺拔，目光中饱含期待。
不知今日又是何峰长老授业讲课。
content_en:
Spirit birds are singing in the empty mountain, and the fragrance of peach blossoms can be smelled.
In the dim light of the morning, in the small courtyard, a wooden sword fell by the well, and a gourd hung on the fence. The young man had been condensing the Yuan Fei for an hour, and fine beads of sweat appeared on his forehead. The process of condensing the Yuan Fei was based on one's own Dantian and communicating the vitality of the world. It was like digging a well on the flat ground. The depth of a well determines whether the water in the well is clear or not.
The quality of the Yuan Fei depends on the color of the Yuan Qi formed when the Yuan Qi is condensed into the Dantian. Green is the best, followed by gray. If you want to condense silver or even gold, you need a great opportunity and an individual to be able to withstand the great pain caused to the body when the mixed Yuan Qi from heaven and earth enters the body.
Gu Yusheng gritted his teeth and persisted.
"Phew!"
About an hour later, Gu Yusheng opened his eyes. His thin body was shaking slightly, his whole body was in a state of weakness, and there were teeth marks on his lips.
"Still cyan."
Gu Yusheng murmured to himself. In the past few days, he had been working day and night to condense the Yuan Fei. The Qi of the Yuan Fei formed in his Dantian was cyan.
In other words, his condensed Yuan Fei is the third grade.
It can barely be counted as a pinyuantai.
But Gu Yusheng was not satisfied.
The realm of Yuan Fei is the starting chapter of the path of spiritual practice. The quality of the Yuan Fei affects how far and how high one can climb in the future.
"Not enough, not working hard enough!"
Gu Yusheng took a short rest and once again practiced the Taiqing Yuantai Spirit Yin Jue. The vitality between heaven and earth was guided into the Dantian. It appeared azure at first, but under Gu Yusheng's condensation, it gradually transformed into a ball of cyan Yuantai Qi.
Green comes from blue and is better than blue!
But the cyan wanted to condense into silver again, but Gu Yusheng was like a blind man crossing the river, groping forward.
He persisted for a while.
There seems to be more cyan energy in the Dantian.
Gu Yusheng sat leaning on the railing, his hands trembling slightly, and took off the wine gourd hanging on the wall, pouring a small sip into his throat.
The physical fatigue quickly subsided, but the spirit contained in the wine was not as magical as it was that day.
After these few days of testing, Gu Yusheng has figured out the function of this magical gourd. It should be able to automatically absorb the spiritual energy from heaven and earth into the wine. This process takes three to five days. Once the spiritual energy integrated into the wine leaves the wine gourd, it will quickly dissipate.
"The speed of my practice is still too slow. If I continue at this speed, in three years, I will be able to enter the state of opening the meridians at most, and the state of opening the meridians requires opening most of the meridians of the human body, and the process will be even longer. If this continues, why should I fight with Lu Chen? How long will it take for me to get back that sword of protection?"
Gu Yusheng took a deep breath.
He has been in Peach Blossom Forest for several days, and has no teacher to guide him in his practice. Every day he can only go to the Demon Suppressing Monument to listen to the elders sent by each peak to lecture on how to condense Yuan Fei.
when.
when.
when.
The bells of Qingyun Gate sound melodiously.
Gu Yusheng changed into a Qingyun Sect costume and quickly ran towards the martial arts field behind the Demon Suppression Monument.
The martial arts arena was already full of people.
They are all new disciples of the Qingyun Sect. The Qingyun Sect occupies the land of the Six Peaks. Although the new disciples are assigned to the Six Peaks, many of them have mediocre talents and can only open small courtyard caves at the foot of the Six Peaks to practice as outer disciples. Only a few can be favored by the elders of the Six Peaks to become inner disciples, and those selected by the master of the Six Peaks are the direct disciples of the Qingyun Sect.
Qingyun Ladder has different levels, and the disciples of Qingyun Sect are also divided into levels.
As for Gu Yusheng, he was a neglected disciple. Although he was also an outer disciple, he actually didn't even have an elder to guide him in his practice. He could only come to the martial arts field every day to listen to the teachings from the elders who were on duty.
Of course, these elders may not be willing to spend all their money to teach others, just to complete the sect's tasks and earn a lot of sect contribution points.
Gu Yusheng found a deserted place to sit cross-legged. Despite this, many people still looked at him and pointed at him.Dot and whisper, but Gu Yusheng has long been used to it and ignores it.
The young man sat cross-legged and upright, his eyes full of expectation.
I wonder if Elder He Feng is giving lectures again today.
